title: Carlson visits quarries exposing the black mat layer

tellings.quote: the black matte layer, which I've visited about three or four um quaries now where you can see the black matte layer exposed.

plain: In a few quarries you can see the "black mat" out in the open, a dark layer in the ground that some researchers tie to an ancient catastrophe. The researcher Randall Carlson says he has gone to three or four of these quarries to look at the layer himself. He mentions it as first-hand support for his view that the layer is real and can be seen.
